name: gesture-swipe-carousel
title: Gesture Swipe Carousel
description: A touch and pointer draggable item reel featuring momentum deceleration and discrete snapping indices.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Horizontal Swipe Carousel: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
